one_off_receipts.what: April 2022 sale of NJ state NOLs and R&D credits (net proceeds, recorded as income tax benefit)
one_off_receipts.quote: During April 2022, we completed the sale of $25.1 million of state NOLs and $0.2 million of R&D credits under the State of New Jersey’s Technology Business Tax Certificate Transfer Program for net proceeds of $2.2 million.
